description: An atmosphere only experiment following piClim-control but with quadrupled CO2 concentration (4xCO2) compared to the pre-industrial (1850) value, but only for the biogeochemical component of the model.  For any other model component that directly uses CO2 concentration, including radiation, the CO2 concentration should be set to the pre-industrial (1850) value, as in piClim-control. All other forcings should be set to pre-industrial (1850) conditions as in piClim-control. Sea Surface Temperatures and Sea Ice Concentrations should be prescribed with the same climatology used in piClim-control.
